summary_en: MP-2606 Inc. completed a tender offer for Sharingtechnology Inc., acquiring 21,614,921 shares including warrant-exercisable shares from September 10 to October 27, 2026. MP-2606 will become the parent company and controlling shareholder on November 4, 2026, with voting power exceeding 50%. Asset Value Investors Limited will cease to be a major shareholder following divestiture of 7,078,700 shares.
title_en: Notice regarding the result of tender offer for shares and warrants of the company by MP-2606 Inc., and notification of changes in parent company and major shareholders
translation_en_brief:
MP-2606 Inc. completed a tender offer for shares and warrants of Sharingtechnology Inc. The offer period ran from September 10, 2026 to October 27, 2026. A total of 21,614,921 shares, including shares exercisable through warrants, were tendered and acquired by MP-2606, exceeding the minimum acceptance threshold of 16,030,200 shares. The offer has been declared successful.

Following settlement on November 4, 2026, MP-2606 will become the parent company and controlling shareholder of Sharingtechnology, with voting power exceeding 50% of total shareholder voting rights. MP-2606 is held 86.93% by MBK Partners JC V, L.P. and 13.07% by Hippo Finance Limited.

Asset Value Investors Limited (AVI), previously the largest shareholder with approximately 7,078,700 shares held through AVI Japan Opportunity Trust Plc and AVI Japanese Special Situations Fund, will divest its entire position through the tender offer. Following settlement, AVI will no longer qualify as a major or principal shareholder of the company.
